js: (async () => { const b = document.getElementById("btn-toggle-hud"); if (b && !document.body.classList.contains("film")) { b.click(); document.body.classList.add("film"); } await (window.CITY.waterEdgesReady || null); })()

name: centre-route-gap-walker-midday
js: (()=>{const a=window.__CITY_APP,C=window.CITY,r=C.waterfrontIslandAccess;const x=-374.4,z=2838.3;a.selectMode("person");a.teleportTo(x,z,0);const s=C.islandAccessSurfaceAt(x,z);if(!s||s.kind!=="route-gap"||!s.pedestrianOnly)throw Error("centre route-gap sampler "+JSON.stringify(s));const g=a.controllerManager.getGroundHeight(x,z,"person");if(Math.abs(g-s.h)>0.08)throw Error("centre walker ground "+g+" != "+s.h);a.cameraSystem.cinema=()=>({pos:[x+7,s.h+1.55,z+7],look:[x,s.h+1.2,z],fov:55});return {h:s.h,ground:g,kind:s.kind};})()

name: hanlans-route-gap-walker-midday
js: (()=>{const a=window.__CITY_APP,C=window.CITY,r=C.waterfrontIslandAccess;const x=-1612.1,z=2518.3;a.selectMode("person");a.teleportTo(x,z,0);const s=C.islandAccessSurfaceAt(x,z);if(!s||s.kind!=="route-gap"||!s.pedestrianOnly)throw Error("hanlans route-gap sampler "+JSON.stringify(s));const g=a.controllerManager.getGroundHeight(x,z,"person");if(Math.abs(g-s.h)>0.08)throw Error("hanlans walker ground "+g+" != "+s.h);a.cameraSystem.cinema=()=>({pos:[x+8,s.h+1.55,z+6],look:[x,s.h+1.2,z],fov:55});return {h:s.h,ground:g,kind:s.kind};})()

name: wards-final-approach-walker-midday
js: (()=>{const a=window.__CITY_APP,C=window.CITY,r=C.waterfrontIslandAccess;const fa=r.layout.routes.ward.finalApproach;if(!fa||!fa.dry||fa.gapM!==44)throw Error("ward final approach missing/not dry "+JSON.stringify(fa));const x=fa.from[0],z=fa.from[1];a.selectMode("person");a.teleportTo(x,z,0);const s=C.islandAccessSurfaceAt(x,z);if(!s)throw Error("ward final mapped point has no walk surface");const g=a.controllerManager.getGroundHeight(x,z,"person");if(Math.abs(g-s.h)>0.1)throw Error("ward endpoint ground "+g+" != "+s.h);a.cameraSystem.cinema=()=>({pos:[x-10,s.h+1.7,z+12],look:[fa.to[0],s.h+0.6,fa.to[1]],fov:52});return {from:fa.from,to:fa.to,gapM:fa.gapM,dry:fa.dry,ground:g,h:s.h};})()

name: island-access-check
js: (()=>{const C=window.CITY,r=C.waterfrontIslandAccess;if(!C.waterfrontIslandAccessEnabled||!r)throw Error("island access disabled");const s=r.stats;if(s.beaches!==4)throw Error("expected 4 beaches, got "+s.beaches);if(!s.accessSpurs||s.accessSpurs<8)throw Error("missing access spurs "+s.accessSpurs);if(!(s.routeGapM>1000))throw Error("missing route-gap walk "+s.routeGapM);if(!s.routeBridgeSegments)throw Error("mapped bridge metadata lost");if(s.routeConnected!==2)throw Error("expected 2 connected routes, got "+s.routeConnected);const ward=r.layout.routes.ward;if(ward.connected)throw Error("Ward must be reported partial, not fully mapped");const fa=ward.finalApproach;if(!fa||fa.kind!=="informal-unmapped-beach-approach"||fa.gapM!==44||!fa.dry||fa.wetM!==0)throw Error("Ward final approach not honest: "+JSON.stringify(fa));for(const c of r.surfaces.corridors.slice(0,6)){const [a,b]=c.nodes;const p=C.islandAccessSurfaceAt((a[0]+b[0])/2,(a[1]+b[1])/2);if(!p||p.h!==c.y||!p.pedestrianOnly)throw Error("sampler mismatch on "+c.kind);}const before=C.waterfrontIslandAccessEnabled;C.waterfrontIslandAccessEnabled=false;const off=C.islandAccessSurfaceAt(r.layout.routes.ward.finalApproach.from[0],r.layout.routes.ward.finalApproach.from[1]);C.waterfrontIslandAccessEnabled=before;if(off!==null)throw Error("sampler not gated");const T=C.THREE;if(T&&T.MeshStandardNodeMaterial){const m=new T.MeshStandardNodeMaterial();C.applyWaterfrontIslandAccessGroundMask(m);if(!m.maskNode)throw Error("bounded lawn mask did not compose before the builder");}console.log("[island-access-check] "+JSON.stringify({beaches:s.beaches,spurs:s.accessSpurs,gapM:s.routeGapM,bridgeSegs:s.routeBridgeSegments,routes:s.routeConnected,wardGap:fa.gapM,benches:s.benches,amenities:s.amenities,signs:s.signs,buildingsAdded:s.buildingsAdded,triangles:s.triangles}));})()
